description: Restore the original tenant context set at session start. ALWAYS call this after cross-tenant queries (nevent_switch_tenant) to avoid leaving your SUPERADMIN account pointing to another tenant. For SUPERADMIN users, tenant switches PERSIST in the user record in the database — this tool reverses that. For OWNER/ADMIN/STAFF users, this resets to the session's home tenant. No parameters needed.
name: nevent_reset_tenant
